user.title: Karlstadsenergi
user.description: Choose data categories (waste only by default) and log in to your Karlstadsenergi account. Categories can be changed later in Configure. Customer number and password is recommended for most users.

data_description.auth_method: Choose customer number & password for the simplest setup. BankID is available as an alternative but requires signing with the BankID app.

bankid_personnummer.title: Karlstadsenergi - BankID
bankid_personnummer.description: Enter your personnummer to start BankID authentication.

data_description.personnummer: Your 10 or 12 digit Swedish personal identity number (e.g. 199001011234).

password.title: Karlstadsenergi - Login
password.description: Enter your customer number and password.

data_description.customer_number: Your customer number (found on your invoice).
data_description.password: Your password for the customer portal.

bankid.title: Karlstadsenergi - BankID
bankid.description:
Sign in with BankID.

**On another device:** scan this QR code with your BankID app. If it does not appear below, [open the QR code]({qr_url}).

![BankID QR code]({qr_url})

**On this device:** [open the BankID app]({bankid_url})

*On a phone, the link above may not open BankID from inside the Home Assistant app. If so, scan the QR code from a computer, or open this page in your phone's browser.*

After signing, click **Submit**.

select_account.title: Karlstadsenergi - Select account
select_account.description: Multiple accounts found. Choose which customer account to use. Each account represents a separate billing relationship with Karlstadsenergi.

data_description.account: Select the customer account to configure.

reauth_confirm.title: Karlstadsenergi - Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Your session has expired. Choose how to sign in again. You can switch method, e.g. from BankID to customer number & password.

data_description.auth_method: Customer number & password is non-interactive and can refresh automatically. BankID requires signing in the app each time.

error.no_features: Select at least one data category.
error.account_locked: This account is locked by Karlstadsenergi. Check the account in the customer portal, then try again.
error.bankid_pending: BankID not yet signed. Open BankID app and try again.

init.title: Options
init.description: Choose which data categories to fetch. Disabling a category stops its updates and entities; existing history is kept. Heating/contracts may require shared portal discovery even without electricity (see README).

data_description.update_interval: Waste refresh interval (1-24 hours). Enabled electricity/heating refresh every max(interval // 6, 1) hours (integer division). Contracts: 24 hours; spot prices: 15 minutes.
data_description.history_years: Years of consumption/cost history to import for enabled electricity and heating only (default: 2). Kept but unused in waste-only mode; existing statistics are never deleted.

error.no_features: Select at least one data category.
error.invalid_interval: Update interval must be between 1 and 24 hours.
error.invalid_history_years: Statistics history must be between 1 and 10 years.
